```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(readODS)
```

```{r}
scores <- read_ods(
  "../data/raw/wimd-2025-index-and-domain-scores-by-small-area.ods",
  sheet = "Data",
  skip  = 3
) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(across(4:12, as.numeric)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(.[[1]]))

cat("Loaded:", nrow(scores), "rows |", ncol(scores), "columns\n")
cat("Column names:\n")
print(names(scores))

```

```{r}
scores  %>%
  pivot_longer(4:12, names_to = "domain",values_to = "score") %>%
  group_by(domain)%>%
  summarise(
    min = round(min(score, na.rm = TRUE),1),
    median = round(median(score, na.rm = TRUE),1),
    mean = round(mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),1),
    max = round(max(score, na.rm = TRUE),1),
    sd = round(sd(score, na.rm = TRUE),1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(max))
```
```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
scores  %>%
  pivot_longer(4:12, names_to = "domain",values_to = "score") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=score))+
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill ="steelblue", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2)+
  facet_wrap(~domain, scales = "free")+
  labs(
    title = "WIMD 2025 score distribution by domain",
    subtitle = "higher score= more deprived. note:scales differ across domains.",
    x = "Score", y = "Count"
  )+
  theme_minimal(
  )
  
```





```{r}
lsoa_col   <- names(scores)[1]   
domain_cols <- names(scores)[5:12]  

scores %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(domain_cols), names_to = "domain", values_to = "score") %>%
  group_by(.data[[lsoa_col]]) %>%
  slice_max(score, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  count(domain, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1))

```

```{r}
round(cor(scores[4:12], use = "complete.obs"), 2)
```


```{r}
scores %>%
  group_by(local_authority_name) %>%
  summarise(
    n            = n(),
    mean_overall = round(mean(wimd_2025,          na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    mean_access  = round(mean(access_to_services, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    mean_housing = round(mean(housing,            na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_access)) %>%
  print(n = 22)


```
